rule.nondecisive: an errored call or a cannot_assess counts as neither verdict and is re-run once
rule.inconclusive: a card with fewer than two decisive replicas after re-runs is inconclusive and blocks
rule.kill_cards: any supported on rc_73d15ca14405 or rc_9e889631af67 blocks
rule.recovery_card: rc_b642fe69b86a needs a majority supported among decisive replicas
rule.control_arm: sanity check only: the current claim text, one replica per card, expected to return the stored baseline verdicts (unsupported / supported / unsupported). One fresh single-condition call cannot prove equivalence to the original batched run, so a mismatch does not block mechanically: it is re-run once, and if still mismatched the card is flagged control_mismatch and the renewed review must state whether that card's candidate result is decisive (a card whose control already gives the candidate's required verdict is uninformative)

ceiling.composition: <= 9 per candidate wording + <= 3 re-runs per wording, at most two wordings by default (a third only if R-1 argues both fail the datedness tie), plus 3 control + <= 3 control re-runs; every call single-condition with <= 3 photos
